Subject: Insurance requirements for Redwood MSA - additional insured and endorsement

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the MSA conversation this week. Procurement is working through our insurance checklist and we hit two items we need to confirm before Procurement will sign the Order Form:

- Additional insured: we need the carrier to endorse our MSA so that Greystone Cloud, Inc. and its subsidiaries are named as Additional Insured on the General Liability and Auto policies.
- Endorsement timing: procurement is asking for confirmation that the insurer will issue a written endorsement (not just a COI note) within 30 days of Order Form execution.

Could you confirm Redwood's carrier contact (broker name and email) so our broker can coordinate the endorsement wording? I attached our checklist for reference. If Redwood cannot obtain an endorsement within 30 days, Procurement will consider a temporary 30-day COI with a follow-up endorsement as an exception — is that something Redwood can accept?

Attachment: Greystone_Insurance_Checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greystone Cloud

Thanks Kimberly/Tom — that plan works for Procurement. Two items from our side:

1) Accept temporary 30-day COI with the additional insured naming you provided, as long as the binder references the Order Form (Redwood Order #4892) and we receive evidence within 48 hours of signature.
2) Please confirm the carrier will deliver the formal endorsement within 30 days; Procurement needs a single point of contact for escalation if the carrier misses that commitment.

We consider this an exception to our typical requirement for the endorsement in-hand at signature, but we'll allow the temporary COI bridge if the endorsement commitment is received in writing and Tom is our broker contact. We're aiming to finalize the Order Form by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Samantha
